sections.title: The suffix you already know, new context
sections.content: You met -kor back in A1 — the exception-to-vowel-harmony suffix that means "at [a time]": hétkor ("at seven"), nyolckor ("at eight"). Nothing new about the suffix itself here, just a routine's worth of new verbs to attach it to.

items.english: I go to bed at midnight.

sections.content: Remember the more formal alternative from A1 too — hét órakor ("at seven o'clock") alongside the everyday hétkor — both are correct, hétkor is just the one you'll reach for in casual conversation.
